scope: FIRST independent actual original PNG inventory for N37 fig64/65 only. Not independent modern figure review or approval.

visible_inventory.description: One oblique-view natural pond/lake scene. Open water fills the central and right portions; a low far bank and irregular vegetation silhouettes run along the upper horizon. Dense foreground vegetation and tree-like vertical forms occupy the left bank, and the near shoreline curves across the bottom.
visible_inventory.future_realization: Genuine contemporary textbook semantic artwork showing still water and a restrained bank, not traced source contours or an abstract ellipse-only replacement.

visible_inventory.description: Multiple nested, broadly concentric oval ripple traces spread across the water around a small central disturbance to the right of image center. Inner traces are more compact and outer traces reach toward the foreground. Several contours are interrupted or irregular because this is a perspective scene drawing.
visible_inventory.future_realization: Artwork must preserve a recognizable localized surface disturbance and outward concentric ripple pattern.
visible_inventory.limits: No reliable exact crest count, wavelength, radius, uniform metric spacing, coordinate, time sequence, or quantitative perspective is specified by the image. Broken strokes are not counted as independent waves, and no measured grid or plot is present.

visible_inventory.description: No point names, numbers, textual labels, directional arrows, scales, axes, dimensions or separate panels appear. No stone in flight, hand, floating matchbox or seagull is visibly identifiable in this PNG.
visible_inventory.future_realization: Do not introduce those contextual prose examples as source-image facts or add labels, measuring guides or arrow overlays.

figures.raw_context: The introducing prose describes concentric ripples after a stone is thrown into still pond/lake water. Later prose explains water-surface waves, outward propagation, approximately equal crest spacing and a floating-matchbox observation; these are context, not extra visible objects in fig64.
figures.semantic_art_premise: The original is a natural water/shore/ripple scene rather than a measured geometry or graph. Replacing the entire scene with hand-authored SVG ellipses would be a semantic-art substitute.

visible_inventory.description: At the left is one tall upright support/post drawn as a narrow vertical rectangular form with a shaded side. The rope is attached at a small knob/anchor on its right edge, approximately midheight.
visible_inventory.limits: No dimensions, calibrated vertical scale or material specification is shown.

visible_inventory.description: One continuous rope runs from the fixed left anchor to a hand at the right. It is nearly horizontal on the left, then has an upward crest, a central downward trough, and another upward crest before entering the grip. The shape is a single snapshot, not a labelled sinusoidal graph.
visible_inventory.limits: No exact amplitude, wavelength, coordinates, phase, tension value, equilibrium guide, displacement arrow, speed value or formula appears.

visible_inventory.description: One recognizable hand enters from the right and visibly grips the rope's right endpoint with fingers and thumb. Part of the wrist/forearm extends out of the right side. The hand is the moving-end actuator described in the prose, not a detached decorative illustration.
visible_inventory.future_realization: Genuine generated hand artwork, registered to the deterministic rope endpoint without distortion. No hand-drawn semantic SVG silhouette or hand icon may replace it.

visible_inventory.description: One bold horizontal left-pointing propagation arrow is above the wavy portion of the rope, oriented from the hand toward the fixed end.
visible_inventory.limits: The arrow is a propagation-direction cue, not a drawn force vector, a hand-displacement arrow, or a measured speed.

visible_inventory.description: No text labels, numbers, ticks, grid, equations, subfigure letters or separate panels appear in the PNG. No reflection snapshot is drawn.
visible_inventory.future_realization: Do not treat neighbouring fig66, fig67 or fig68 as part of this figure, or invent a second reflected pulse panel.

figures.raw_context: The full p0105#7/p0106#1 passage describes a rubber rope with one end fixed, the other held and vibrated by hand. Waves travel along the rope, reflect at the fixed end, and each rope segment oscillates about equilibrium; the transverse-motion illustration is separately referenced as fig66.
figures.semantic_art_premise: The hand gripping the driven rope endpoint is indispensable semantic apparatus. Rope continuity, attachment/grip registration and the leftward propagation arrow must be deterministic; a generated PNG alone must not own these exact relationships.
